---
site: bookdown::bookdown_site
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Absolute project root — used by the Stata chapter so collectcode does not
# depend on whatever working directory bookdown happens to be in.
mics_guide_root <- if (file.exists("_bookdown.yml")) {
  normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else if (file.exists("../_bookdown.yml")) {
  normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else {
  normalizePath(".", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
options(mics.guide.root = mics_guide_root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = mics_guide_root)
setwd(mics_guide_root)

# Stata engine. Chapters show Stata code with eval=FALSE by default, so a
# local Stata installation is not required to build the book.
stataexe <- "C:/Program Files/Stata18/StataMP-64.exe"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  engine.path = list(stata = stataexe),
  cache = FALSE
)

if (requireNamespace("Statamarkdown", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(Statamarkdown)
}
```
